rules.format: Mechanical punctuation, word budget, single-line interrogative form, no recognized extra response and normalized previous-question repetition. Language is separately inconclusive.
rules.reflection_structure: Recognizable learner-directed strategy, decision, evidence or planning patterns versus recognizable technical recall. Pattern classification is not proof of educational usefulness.
rules.contextual_grounding: Explicit references to supplied fields and grounded named technologies. Lexical overlap is descriptive only; absence of overlap does not imply irrelevance.
rules.factual_grounding: Recognized assertions about time, quantities, progress, recorded control answers and performance. Missing evidence, hypothetical alternatives and conflicting records are distinguished. Unrecognized claims require review.
rules.agency_wording: Listed direct coercion, ability judgments, emotion/performance premises and diagnoses. No detected wording pattern is not proof of appropriate tone.

purpose: Retrospective evaluation on original outputs; frozen before computing method aggregates
